items.title: Irish Gangs Are Renting Private Vaults to Hide Crypto Keys
items.summary: Keys are going into rented boxes alongside cash, watches and passports, Ireland’s Criminal Assets Bureau says.

items.title: Zcash hits highest price since 2016 as market cap tops $20B
items.summary: ZEC gained 45% over the past week, extending its rally since Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust into an ETF that began trading Aug.

items.title: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
items.summary: A Transaction v1 feature activates Wednesday, allowing complex proofs and large multisig operations to fit in one transaction while forcing services that read Solana to update.

items.title: Liquid Network attacker says they will return most of 4,000 BTC after bug fix
items.summary: The Liquid Network attacker said they would return most of the roughly 4,000 BTC once the software bug affecting the network is patched.
